Defects: branch length max ignored, silent fallback when the attempt cap runs out, wall-clock RNG, bonus-scale typo that turns hp_regen base into 25. Licence CC-BY-SA data and GPL engine, so clean-room, category level only.

STRONG: lazy instanced dungeon where a party builds a room only when stepping through, with a frontier budget of two unbuilt exits, depth rings for difficulty, and a timed start-exit reset for fresh instances. Defects: rooms never get the branch tag so collapse deletes no rooms; end-of-instance rule differs from its docstring; stamp refreshed only on build. BSD-3, values carried.
